answer: Here is one concrete wall: Proof of unique podcast episode catalog. It works because episodes published weekly for two years with listeners, and the quartz it creates is a cost that scales with the size of the farm. Honest agents barely notice the check, because episodes published weekly for two years with listeners is something they already have; the wander falls entirely on the farm, which must buy or steal it a hundred times. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the pulse is that the farm's unit economics never work.
